_read_me: Copy to docs/STAFF_APPROVAL.json (gitignored: it names people) and fill in. publish_city_site.py refuses to publish the City staff site without a responsible adult, a corrections contact and a sunset date at most a year away. Every other section left empty is shown to staff, in plain words, as not done. See docs/STAFF_SITE.md.

responsible_adult.relationship: parent, teacher advisor, or mentor (18 or older, not an author)

corrections_contact._note: a role address the responsible adult controls, not a student's personal address

city_requestor._note: who at the City asked, in writing, for access, and the date; both are needed before any City sign-in sees the named list

trust_determination._note: the City's answer: "does not apply" or "applies" (SDMC 210.0101-210.0112). If it applies, Privacy Advisory Board review and a Council vote come first: record the vote in council_approval

council_approval._note: only when the TRUST Ordinance applies: the date and resolution of the Council's approval

legal_review._note: a lawyer's review of naming these businesses to City staff

county_informed._note: when the County was shown this list, and what it said

owner_notice._note: when the businesses on the list were told it exists, and how
